assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Create a new camera view of the same fictional adult man in Image 1: a clear THREE-QUARTER HEAD-AND-SHOULDERS portrait at approximately 40–45 degrees, face pointing toward the viewer's right.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1 is the primary edit target and the approved source of identity, youthful adult age, expression, gaze quality, short dark wavy hair, pale gray-blue iris color, clothing and lighting mood.
Image 2 is a geometric cross-check of the SAME man's profile ONLY: use its nose projection, natural lip-to-chin relationship, jaw depth and compact back of head to make the intermediate view coherent. Do not import its eye direction, expression, lip separation, lighting or apparent age.

CAMERA CHANGE:
Imagine Image 1 is a real still scene. Keep the man quietly watching the very same person at his own eye height in front of him, and move the camera around to the man's left by about 40–45 degrees. The man does not turn to follow the camera. Both eyes must remain visible but the far eye and far cheek must be distinctly foreshortened. Show a real intermediate view between the supplied front and profile, rather than another almost-frontal portrait. Camera stays at eye height, with a natural portrait-lens perspective. Frame entire hair, head, neck and shoulders.

PRESERVE THE PERFORMANCE:
Keep the approved expression from Image 1: sustained, settled attention and private intent; quiet brow, softly CLOSED resting lips, no new emotional reaction. His eyes look horizontally in the direction his nose points, at the same unseen person, not upward and not back toward the moved camera. Preserve the eye opening and naturally shaped brow without lifting or squeezing them. Maintain his existing comfortable head-to-neck alignment, neutral chin and settled shoulders. No head cock, questioning face, startled eyes, pout, smirk, scowl or sleepy expression. Let the reference supply the character; do not exaggerate authority or intelligence.

IDENTITY AND LIGHT:
Preserve facial length and width under correct perspective, original cheek fullness and cheekbone structure, the continuous refined chin and the natural hollow beneath the lower lip. Do not widen the chin, create a cleft, protrude the mouth, hollow the cheeks or age him. Keep Image 1's low-saturation pale gray-blue irises, with a darker natural outer rim and existing lighting differences between the eyes. Preserve directional side light with readable eyes and sculptural facial shadows; adapt it plausibly to the camera change while keeping the same restrained color and skin texture. Same black shirt, textured dark jacket and subdued interior. One photorealistic color photograph, vertical 3:4. No additional people, objects, text or collage.
